transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess… sleep, mostly. I’m barely sleeping in any way that helps. I lie there going over client models in my head, and then I’m up at 3 or 4 with my stomach tight. By the time I go to work, it feels like I haven’t rested at all.
How long have you been having trouble sleeping like this?
About three years, I think. It started after the merger, when they reorganized our Caribbean-market division. Since then it’s just… been this way.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot or feeling anxious quite often, even when there isn’t something specific happening?
I don’t know. I mean… I think about things a lot, but I’m not sure I’d call it anxiety. It’s just kind of always there.
Do you find that your worries or the thoughts you have are hard to control or seem to take over your mind, even when you try to focus on something else?
I’m not sure. Sometimes it’s hard to switch off, I guess, but… I don’t know if I’d say it takes over. It’s more like it’s just in the background and I keep coming back to it.
Do you often feel tired or like you don’t have any energy, even after trying to rest?
I mean… maybe sometimes. It’s hard to tell. I don’t really feel rested much, but I’ve kind of gotten used to it.
Do you find that you worry about a variety of things most days, even when you try not to?
I don’t really know. I mean, I think about things a lot, but whether it’s “worrying about a variety of things”… I’m not sure. It’s just kind of there.
Do you find yourself worrying about a number of different things—like work, family, health, or other responsibilities—on most days, even when you try not to?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I think about things, but I don’t know that I’d call it worrying about all those different areas most days. It’s just… hard to separate out.
Do you often feel fatigued or like you have no energy, even when you’ve had some rest or on days when you’re not particularly tired from lack of sleep?
I’m not sure how to answer that. I don’t feel energetic most of the time, but I can’t really say if it’s fatigue exactly or just… normal for me at this point.
Do you find that you feel anxious or worried about things even when there’s no clear reason to be, and does it seem to happen more often than not?
I don’t know. I wouldn’t say there’s no reason… there’s usually something, even if it’s small. I guess I haven’t really noticed it happening more often than not.
Do you find yourself worrying about a number of different things—like work, family, health, or other responsibilities—on most days, even when you try not to?
I don’t really know. I mean, I think about things, sure, but “worrying about a number of things most days” sounds more specific than I can really say.
Do you find that you feel anxious or worried about things most days, even when there isn’t an immediate problem, and does this bother you or interfere with your daily life?
I’m not really sure. I wouldn’t say it’s most days, or not most days… I just haven’t tracked it like that. It bothers me sometimes, I guess, but I don’t know if I’d call it interfering.
Can you recall any recent days when you’ve had a full night’s sleep or some time to rest, and on those days, did you feel any more energetic or less fatigued than usual?

Not really. Even if I’m in bed long enough, it doesn’t feel like useful sleep. I’ll lie there going over client models, and then I’m up around 3 or 4 with my stomach tight. So… no, I don’t usually feel more rested after.
Even when you have the chance to get a full night’s sleep, do you still wake up feeling unrested or like your sleep wasn’t restful?
Yes. Even when I’m in bed long enough, it doesn’t really feel like I slept properly. I wake up early—like 3 or 4—and then I go to work feeling like I never actually rested.
Have you ever had periods where you felt down or lost interest in things you usually enjoy, even for a little while?

Yes… I mean, most days there’s this heavy feeling. At work, at home too. I’m still doing what I’m supposed to do, but it feels like I’m just moving through it. Sometimes even a normal question from someone makes me feel like I might cry.
Have you noticed that you don’t enjoy things as much as you used to, even activities that you previously found pleasurable?
I’m… not sure. I don’t really think about it that way. I still do things when I need to, but whether I enjoy them… I don’t know.
Have you noticed that you don’t enjoy things as much as you used to, even activities that you previously found pleasurable?
I don’t really know. I haven’t paid much attention to that, I guess. Things feel… muted sometimes, but I’m not sure I’d say I don’t enjoy them.
Do you often feel a lack of energy or increased fatigue during the day, even on days when your sleep wasn’t particularly bad?
I’m not sure. I get tired, but I don’t really know if it’s more than normal. I haven’t paid close attention to it.
Do you often feel down or sad most of the day, nearly every day, even if it's just a heavy or unmotivated feeling?

Yeah… most days, I think. It’s not always like crying outright, but there’s this heavy, gray feeling. I’ll be at work or at home and I’m just… getting through things, trying not to fall apart over normal questions.
Do you find it hard to focus or think clearly, especially when you're at work or trying to handle daily tasks?

Yes… especially at work. Spreadsheets that used to be automatic take me hours now. I’ll reread the same assumptions again and again, lose track of what I was doing, and still feel like I probably missed something obvious before a presentation.
